description: Measure checkout conversion at the ATTEMPT level, where users can start checkout several times. Every 'start_checkout' event opens a new attempt. A 'purchase' event completes the same user's most recent preceding attempt, provided the purchase occurs no more than 60 minutes after that attempt's start (inclusive) and the attempt has not already been completed. Purchases with no qualifying attempt are ignored. Report per UTC date of the attempt start. Output columns: attempt_date (DATE), attempts (INT64), completed_attempts (INT64), attempt_conversion (FLOAT64, 4 decimals), users_attempting (INT64), users_converting (INT64).
edge_cases: User 1 has two attempts and one purchase: only the second (most recent) attempt is completed
User 2's purchase comes 90 minutes after the start and does not complete the attempt
User 3 purchases without any start_checkout; the purchase is ignored
Two purchases after a single start complete that attempt only once
common_failure_modes: FM1: Joining every start to every later purchase of the user marks both of user 1's attempts as completed
FM3: User-level conversion (1/2 = 0.5) reported instead of attempt-level conversion (1/3)
FM2: Omitting the 60-minute bound counts user 2's late purchase
